Messages.Author: galliard
Messages.Body:
hello guys
can Basilia/Thetmes or other vampire with similar ability strike aggravated with Bundi?
Is all damage aggravated this way or only part of (like in Burning Wrath case)

Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
yes they do. All the damage is aggravated.

Card text :
Bundi
Equipment
Melee weapon.
Strike: hand strike at +1 damage. (This strike is both a hand strike and a melee weapon strike). Bearer may prevent 1 damage from each melee weapon strike made against him or her.

Imagination is our only weapon in the war against reality -Jules de Gaultier
